citations.desc: Environment enhancement to promote psychological well-being.
citations.narrative:
The avian environment enhancement plan approved by the attending veterinarian states that the birds will be socially
housed. There is an adult Blue and Gold Macaw "Morgan" that is housed alone and does not have a written plan for
special attention regarding enhancement of his environment based on being an individually housed social species of bird
that is unable to see or hear birds of his own or compatible species. Lack of additional enrichment for an individually
housed social bird may contribute to poor psychological welfare. The plan must address birds in the special
considerations categories. Corrected at time of inspection.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the facility representatives.
Additional Inspectors:
Ronald Richardson, VETERINARY MEDICAL OFFICER n
